Many members of the troll tribes have gathered here to watch and help defeat the heroes of the Horde and Alliance. After continuing onward, adventurers pass through another long stretch of the Ruined Approach towards the Lightning Promenade.

The Roughnecks are a human group in Tiragarde Sound. They provide all gryphon mounts for Kul Tiras. They are led by Boss Tak, a Wildhammer dwarf of the Doyle clan from the Twilight Highlands, who taught them how to tame and ride gryphons instead of hunting them for meat and pelts. They were apparently also taught about preserving the local wild population that their gryphons are captured from. This includes driving off saurolisks if they overrun the nests, as the residents could make new roosts elsewhere that's inconvenient for the Roughnecks. They also construct new nests for displaced gryphons and place eggs from abandoned nests within them, as females will likely choose to adopt the eggs.

The Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj is a 10-man (20-man before ) outdoor raid dungeon located in southern Silithus, released with patch 1.9. Its release was joined by a massive server-dependent event called the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. It can be found by entering the main Ahn'Qiraj Gate and continuing on the left path. Most of the area is mountable, however, the bug mounts from the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj do not work here. If any member of your party is in combat then your entire party is in combat no matter where they are in the instance. It uses a similar loot system to what Zul'Gurub used, via tokens dropped from bosses which are used to complete quests that give item rewards. Additionally, the quests can only

AQ20 loot-quests require tokens which drop from bosses, combined with a certain level of faction with the Cenarion Circle. (Zul'Gurub uses a similar system). Players must collect ten scarab items of two types, two idols of a certain type, and a single Qiraji item. When a player has the appropriate collection for a particular item and a certain level of reputation with Cenarion Circle, they can turn them in for the item at Cenarion Hold.

This page lists the loot found on bosses in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. Trash Mobs in AQ20 have a small chance to drop epic and rare items, however these are not specific to the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj. The trash mobs also drop the uncommon scarabs and rare idols needed for the Ahn'Qiraj loot quests. All the bosses in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj also have a chance of drop one of several enchanting formulas, which can also drop (and are more likely to drop) in the Temple of Ahn'Qiraj. These tables below are a comprehensive list of all the possible loot obtained from the bosses. The Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj is also the only place to find the loot listed below.
Ruga's Bulwark was a quest reward from Trial at the Field of Giants.
The Ruins of Ravenwind are the remains of an ancient Kaldorei civilization in northern Feralas, specifically the Highborne (much like Dire Maul). It is currently overrun with Northspring harpies.
Rude Awakening is the first quest that an undead character will complete. This quest is exclusive to undead characters.
Rudra Amberstill is a dwarf quest giver located at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. She was present during the Legion Invasions.

The Ruins of Aboraz is a collection of ancient troll ruins on the southeastern coast of Stranglethorn Vale, now the home of the witch doctor Zanzil the Outcast. Zanzil's ghoul, naga, and troll minions wander the ruins, and the captured Darkspear troll Yenniku is also here as a thrall of Zanzil. The bewitched debtor to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley, Chucky "Ten Thumbs", also roams the ruins as a ghoul. It is located southeast of Ruins of Jubuwal, east of Spirit Den, and south of Crystalvein Mine.

The Ruins of Zul'Kunda are very large jungle troll ruins in Northern Stranglethorn. This is the territory of the Bloodscalp tribe, and their leaders, Nezzliok the Dire and Gan'zulah, are stationed here. It is accessed via a path heading east from Zuuldaia Ruins.

Ruins of Jubuwal are ancient troll ruins, just east of the Gurubashi Arena, along main road that spans the length of Stranglethorn Vale. Ghoul, naga, and troll minions of Zanzil the Outcast currently inhabit the ruins, including Jon-Jon the Crow and Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins, debtors to the ruthless "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
Ruga Ragetotem is a tauren quest giver located in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, presumably having been killed in the Alliance raid on the camp.

The Ruins of Sha'naar are the remains of an old draenei temple, located south of the Cenarion Post in Hellfire Peninsula. It is now occupied by Illidari terrorguards and their unwilling Dreghood broken servants. The cruel demon Arzeth the Merciless is stationed here, leading the excavation of the ruins to find one of the Ata'mal crystals for Illidan Stormrage. However according to Naladu, it's likely not even here.

The Ruins of Enkaat are all that remain of a draenei settlement in western Netherstorm. The cause of the town's destruction is unknown, though it may have been caused by the same sundering that led to the creation of Netherstorm and greater Outland. Based upon the arrangement of skeletons and crates of belongings scattered about the ruins, as well as the presence of the now-spectral vindicators that wander the area, it can be surmised that the settlement was in the process of being evacuated at the time of its destruction. Ruin is a warlock talent, considered to be the cornerstone of the Destruction talent tree, that increases the critical hit damage bonus of your Destruction spells by up to 100%. A normal spell critical is +50% damage taking into account all other damage modifiers. Ruin doubles the critical bonus when maxed, so you get a +100% damage bonus on critical hits.

The Rubbing: Rune of Markri was obtained from the Rune of Markri in Azshara when using the Drawing Kit.
Ru'zah can be found dancing in the inn of Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest .
The Rugwood Mantle was a quest reward from The Dunemaul Compound.

Ru'sad is a Scourge necromancer in charge of the undead forces found in Zul'Aman. He is under the command of leaders in Stratholme. He is interested in killing the high elves found in the troll forests to prevent them from rejoining any allies in Hillsbrad or Khaz Modan, in order to prevent them from reviving the Sunwell. He had sent gargoyles, ghouls, and zombies into the jungles to look for them. Brann killed one of these gargoyles during his journey in Zul'Aman and found a letter written by Ru'sad on its corpse, giving hints that the lost and scattered high elves, still had importance.
Ruined Tomes are looted from Musty Tomes in the Ruins of Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands. Truly worthless as they are, they can't even be sold to vendors.
The Ruinous Polyspore is located northeast of Blood Watch and around Wrathscale Lair on Bloodmyst Isle.

__NOTOC__ The Ruby Shades are a piece of head slot clothing that provides no bonuses or armor. They have no level requirement, do not bind (unless they are enchanted and the enchantment binds them), and can be equipped by any class. Unfortunately, as of patch 3.0.8, they are no longer being vended, but can occasionally be found on the auction house.
Ruby Watchers are red drakes located at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight.
Ruby Keepers are red dragons locked in combat with the Scourge forces at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight.
Ruby Guardians are red dragonspawn locked in combat with the Scourge forces at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight. They also appear in the Deaths of Chromie in the same area.
__NOTOC__ Ruby Pigment is rarely obtained when milling: * Firebloom * Purple Lotus * Arthas' Tears * Sungrass * Blindweed * Ghost Mushroom * Gromsblood)

The Ruins of Eldra'nath are ancient night elf ruins now inhabited by Imperean and his air elementals. These ruins are found just west of Bor'gorok Outpost and north of Blistering Pool in the Borean Tundra. The air elementals that reside here have become enraged during the war between the fire and water elementals nearby.
Ruby Void is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Ley-Guardian Eregos in the Oculus on Heroic difficulty without anyone in your party using a Ruby Drake.
The Ruined Court is an outdoor chamber of Utgarde Pinnacle, the last chamber before entering the throne room of King Ymiron.
The Ruby Brooch drops from Dahlia Suntouch at the Ruby Dragonshrine in the Dragonblight.
A ruffian is any rough, ne'er-do-well who prefers to communicate with violence rather than words.
__NOTOC__ Rugan Steelbelly is a dwarf found in the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He is the master of the Charge. During Death Rising, he was patrolling and defending the grounds.
The Ruins of Drak'Zin are ice troll ruins found in the Grizzly Hills.
Rubble and Roll (10 player) is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for defeating Kologarn after causing at least 25 Rubble creatures to spawn on 10-player mode.
Ruj'kah is a Horde hunter and is one of the possible opponents for Alliance in the Faction Champions battle in the Trial of the Crusader raid instance.
Two Influence Tentacles disguised as Ruby Consorts can be seen in the Forging of the Demon Soul vision during the Yogg-Saron encounter in Ulduar.
This article outlines loot dropped in the raid instance Ruby Sanctum. === 10-player mode ===

The Ruby Beacon of the Dragon Queen is provided by Torastrasza for On Ruby Wings. It allows you to summon a Wyrmrest Vanquisher to help blast foes in the Dragon Wastes, Galakrond's Rest and the Wicked Coil. The Wyrmrest Vanquisher has fiery breath, and can (if necessary) devour ghouls - roasted or raw.
Ruins of Vashj'elan is naga infested Highborne ruins located in southern Lost Isles. Faceless of the Deep is the leader of the naga in these ruins.

Ruins of Thelserai Temple is an ancient highborne temple located directly east of the Silver Tide Trench in the Shimmering Expanse. Toshe Chaosrender chased Fathom-Lord Zin'jatar and his naga forces here from the Damplight Chamber.

Ruins of Lornesta is a subzone of Darkshore. It is a flooded ruin full of Darkscale Scouts led by Lady Janira. Fuming Toadstools can also be found here. By the time of the Battle for Darkshore, a cave opened up which came to be called the Lornesta Mine. It contains :Azerite. When the Alliance controls Darkshore, they control the ruins. When the Horde controls Darkshore, the Darkscale naga control the ruins.
]] The Ruins of Kargath lie within the Badlands. The area is now overrun with Nyxondra's Broodlings, small black dragon whelps, guarded by their ever watchful parent, Nyxondra.

Ruk Warstomper is a tauren battlemaster located on the Hunter Rise of Thunder Bluff. Shortly after the Cataclysm, Ruk dealt with the quilboar problem in Mulgore. During the Fourth War, he was encountered by the Alliance forces at Bael Modan in Southern Barrens.

Ruins of Ammon was a tol'vir temple that now lies in ruins in southwestern Uldum. The ruins are infested by Eternal Protectors and Furious Specters that have been attacking and killing troopers from Schnottz's Landing that try to enter the ruins to collect relics. A brazier sits in the middle of the temple grounds still burning. After N'Zoth was released, the ruins became a breeding ground for aqir.
__NOTOC__ Rugged Trapper's Vest is the starting chest piece for Human, Dwarf, Night Elf and Undead Hunters.
Rugelfuss's Status Report is provided as an objective for Onward to Thelsamar.
Ruby Seeds are provided as an objective for Life from Death.

The Ruins of Nordressa is an area west of the Northern Rocketway Exchange where the Image of Archmage Xylem is located along with several of his apprentices. The quest chains involving Xylem start here, initiated by Sorata Firespinner, a burnt-out apprentice who gives players an apprentice's hat and sends them here. The entrance to this area is on the eastern side of the encampment around and is marked by a series of torches. After players have completed some tasks for Xylem and his apprentices, they will be sent to the Arcane Pinnacle, where Xylem's trials take place.
The Ruins of Lar'donir are some night elven ruins in the northern part of the Verdant Thicket of Mount Hyjal. The green dragon Alysra can be found here.
__NOTOC__ Ruberick is a stone lord quest giver found in Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.
The following NPCs can be found inside the Ruby Sanctum instance.
Rugfizzle's Boots is a quest reward from A Little Payback (Horde). The Alliance version is Drag Master's Boots
